current_concerns.primary_problems: Um, mostly the eating stuff again — I’ve been restricting and counting calories since I was 18, and even though my weight has gone up some over the past year, I’m still really stuck on body shape and I avoid eating with other people. It kind of takes over my day, honestly.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to be able to eat a meal with friends without spending days planning it first.
